front.situation: 料理教室で、講師がパンケーキの作り方を説明している。あなたはワークシートのイラストを正しい順に並べる。
choices: Putting a tray into an oven
Mixing flour, eggs and milk in a bowl with a whisk
Cooking one side in a frying pan, small bubbles on the surface
Flipping the pancake over in the frying pan
A pancake on a plate with syrup being poured on it
front.script: Good morning, everyone. Today I'll show you how I make my favorite pancakes. To start off, put the flour, eggs and milk in a bowl and mix them until smooth. Next, pour the batter into a hot frying pan and cook one side until small bubbles appear on the surface. When you see those bubbles, flip it over and cook the other side for about a minute. Finally, slide it onto a plate and pour plenty of maple syrup on top. And by the way, you never need an oven for this recipe.
front.explain: 順序標識 To start off → Next → When you see those bubbles → Finally を追う素直な構成。最後の you never need an oven でオーブンのイラスト①が明確に除外される（ダミー）。「片面を焼く→泡が出たらひっくり返す」という因果のつながりが③→④の根拠。
keyPhrases: To start off, put the flour, eggs and milk in a bowl
cook one side until small bubbles appear on the surface
flip it over and cook the other side
Finally, slide it onto a plate and pour plenty of maple syrup
you never need an oven for this recipe

back.situation: 学校のカフェテリアで、職員が今週のランチ特別メニューを説明している。あなたは表の空欄を埋める。
back.script: Here's this week's lunch special. On Monday we're starting with something warm — a stew with seasonal vegetables, and no meat at all. Tuesday is for our fish lovers: fried cod with chips. On Wednesday the chef makes his famous pie with chicken and mushrooms. Thursday is a cold dish — a bowl of pasta with tomatoes and olives, served cold. Friday, as always, is students' choice. Oh, and the beef curry everyone keeps asking about? That's next month, I'm afraid.

fried cod with chips
his famous pie with chicken and mushrooms
a bowl of pasta with tomatoes and olives, served cold

partB.situation: あなたは文化祭でクラスの出し物を1つ選ぼうとしている。4人の意見を聞き、3つの条件をすべて満たすものを選ぶ。
conditionsEn: A. No money is needed to prepare it
B. Ten students or fewer can run it
C. One round finishes in 30 minutes or less
conditionsJa: A. 準備にお金がかからないこと
B. 10人以下で運営できること
C. 1回あたり30分以内で終わること
partB.question: You are most likely to choose ( 26 ).
scripts: A haunted house would be really exciting. We'd have to buy black curtains and costumes, though, so it isn't cheap. And we'd need about fifteen people to scare the visitors properly. The good news is that each tour only takes ten minutes.

How about a magic show? The cards and ropes are already in our classroom, so we don't have to spend a single yen. Two of us perform and three guide the audience — five people in total. Each show runs for twenty minutes.
A café sounds nice. We could bring tea bags from home, but we'd still have to buy cups, sugar and cookies. Eight of us could run it easily, and customers usually stay for about twenty minutes.

Let's do a giant puzzle corner. The art club will lend us their puzzle for free, and only three of us are needed at a time. The one problem is the time — finishing one puzzle takes about forty-five minutes.
partB.explain: ①はA（黒幕と衣装を買う＝有料）とB（15人）の2点で失格。③はA（カップ・砂糖・クッキーを買う）で失格。ここは we could bring tea bags from home「家から持ってくる」に安心せず、but 以降を聞き取ることが鍵。④はC（45分）で失格。②のみ A（we don't have to spend a single yen）・B（five people in total）・C（twenty minutes）の3条件すべてを満たす。
keyPhrases: so it isn't cheap
we'd need about fifteen people
we don't have to spend a single yen
five people in total
we'd still have to buy cups, sugar and cookies
finishing one puzzle takes about forty-five minutes

front.situation: 市立図書館の職員が、4種類の資料の貸出割合が5年間でどう変化したかを説明している。あなたはグラフの4本の線がそれぞれ何を表すかを答える。

blanks.label: the line that starts highest and keeps falling
the line that rises every year
the line that drops to the lowest position
the line that stays almost flat

front.script: Let me show you how borrowing at our library has changed over five years. Paper books started at the top and have gone down every single year, though they are still number one. E-books tell the opposite story — they have risen steadily and now come second. DVDs were once quite popular, but they have fallen the most sharply of all, and today they sit at the very bottom. Comics have hardly moved at all; the figure is almost the same as it was in 2021.
front.explain: 4本の線と4つのカテゴリを対応させる本試験型（2025年度と同形式）。gone down every single year（④Paper books＝一貫下降・ただし依然1位）、risen steadily（③E-books）、fallen the most sharply / at the very bottom（②DVDs）、hardly moved at all（①Comics＝ほぼ横ばい）。「下降」が2つ（Paper booksとDVDs）あるため、下降の程度と最終順位で区別するのが鍵。
keyPhrases: Paper books started at the top and have gone down every single year
E-books tell the opposite story
they have risen steadily and now come second
they have fallen the most sharply of all, and today they sit at the very bottom
Comics have hardly moved at all

back.situation: 同じ図書館の職員が、館内4つのエリアの利用ルールを説明している。あなたは表の空欄を埋める。
back.script: Now, about our four areas. The Reading Room closes at eight, and you may bring a drink, but only in a bottle with a lid — no open cups. The Study Booths stay open the longest, right up to nine, though you do need to book one first. The Group Room shuts at six and, as the name suggests, it cannot be used by fewer than four people. And the Café Corner, where drinks are of course fine, closes two hours before the Reading Room does.
back.explain: ①と③の区別が要点。Reading Room は a drink, but only in a bottle with a lid なので①Drinks in bottles only。③No talking at all は一切言及されないダミー。Group Room の cannot be used by fewer than four people（4人未満は不可）＝②Four people or more の言い換え。Café Corner は closes two hours before the Reading Room（＝8時の2時間前）で⑤7:00 p.m. を計算させる。④5:00 p.m. は未使用。
keyPhrases: you may bring a drink, but only in a bottle with a lid
stay open the longest, right up to nine
it cannot be used by fewer than four people
closes two hours before the Reading Room does

partB.situation: あなたは週末に通う語学教室を1つ選ぼうとしている。4人の説明を聞き、3つの条件をすべて満たすものを選ぶ。
conditionsEn: A. You can take a lesson that starts after 8 p.m.
B. The monthly fee is 10,000 yen or less
C. Lessons can be taken online
conditionsJa: A. 夜8時より後に始まる授業を受けられること
B. 月謝が1万円以下であること
C. オンラインで受講できること
partB.question: You are most likely to choose ( 26 ).
scripts: I go to River English. The building is open until ten at night, and the last lesson begins at eight thirty, which suits me after work. Eight thousand yen a month is reasonable, too. The one thing is that every lesson is face to face — they have no online classes.

Globe Language School is where I study. You can join any lesson online whenever you like, and the evening classes run until nine thirty. It's twelve thousand yen a month, which is a bit more than the others, but the teachers really are excellent.

I'm at Sun English. It's the cheapest — only seven thousand yen a month — and they finally started online lessons this spring. The problem for me is the schedule. The final lesson of the day begins at six thirty, so nothing runs late in the evening.

My school is Moon Language. The last lesson of the day starts at eight thirty, and the fee is nine thousand yen a month. Half of the lessons can be taken online from home, which helps a lot on busy days.
partB.explain: ①はC（no online classes）で失格。open until ten という数字に引っかからず、the last lesson begins at eight thirty が条件Aの判定材料であることに注意。②はB（12,000円）で失格。③はA（最終授業が6時半開始）で失格 — cheapest と online started という好条件に惑わされないこと。④のみ A（starts at eight thirty）・B（nine thousand yen）・C（Half of the lessons can be taken online）を満たす。条件Aは「始まる時刻」で判定する点が全体の仕掛け。

they have no online classes
It's twelve thousand yen a month
The final lesson of the day begins at six thirty
the fee is nine thousand yen a month
Half of the lessons can be taken online from home

front.situation: 生徒がクラスで、先週の高校オープンキャンパスで回った順序を報告している。あなたはワークシートのイラストを訪問順に並べる。
choices: A student reading a newspaper at a library desk
Many visitors sitting in a gym listening to a speech on a stage
A student in a science room watching liquid bubble in a glass flask
A student holding a violin under his chin in a music room
A student eating a slice of cake at a cafeteria table
front.script: Last Saturday I went to the open day at Midtown High, and I'd like to tell you what I did. First, all the visitors gathered in the gym for a welcome talk by the principal. After that, I went straight to the music room and got to try a violin for the very first time. Then I spent about half an hour in the library, reading their collection of old newspapers. To finish the day, I had a piece of chocolate cake in the cafeteria. I did want to see the chemistry experiment, but the science room was closed for repairs.
front.explain: First → After that → Then → To finish the day の4つの順序標識を追う標準型。ダミーは③の理科室で、最後の but the science room was closed for repairs によって明確に否定される。②gym →④violin →①library →⑤cafeteria の順であり、選択肢の番号順とは一致しないため、番号ではなく絵の内容で照合する必要がある。
keyPhrases: all the visitors gathered in the gym for a welcome talk
I went straight to the music room and got to try a violin
Then I spent about half an hour in the library
To finish the day, I had a piece of chocolate cake in the cafeteria

back.situation: 担任の先生が、ボランティアデーの班ごとの作業内容を説明している。あなたは表の空欄を埋める。
back.script: Here is the plan for Volunteer Day. Group A, meet me at the school gate, because you will put new flowers in the beds along the front path. Group B, take the bus to the nursery school; you will be reading picture books to the children there. Group C goes to Riverside Park to collect rubbish along the water. And Group D, at the station square, will give the old wall by the bike park a fresh coat of paint. Bring gloves, everyone. We had planned to wash the library windows too, but that job has been put off until next term.

you will be reading picture books to the children there
Group C goes to Riverside Park to collect rubbish along the water

partB.situation: あなたは中古自転車を1台買おうとしている。4人の説明を聞き、3つの条件をすべて満たす店の自転車を選ぶ。
conditionsEn: A. It costs 20,000 yen or less
B. It has a basket
C. It can be delivered to your home
conditionsJa: A. 2万円以下であること
B. かごが付いていること
C. 自宅まで配達してもらえること
partB.question: You are most likely to choose ( 26 ).
scripts: The bicycle at Sky Cycle is eighteen thousand yen, so it fits your budget nicely. It already has a large metal basket on the front. And because you live inside the city, the shop will bring it to your door at no extra charge.

Green Wheels has a nice one for only fifteen thousand yen, and it comes with a basket big enough for a school bag. The problem is that the shop has no van at all, so you would have to ride it home yourself on the day.

Town Bike sells a very light model with a wide basket, and they deliver anywhere in the prefecture for free. However, it is twenty-five thousand yen, which is five thousand over the limit you set. It really is a lovely bike, though.

At Happy Ride there is a twelve-thousand-yen bicycle, and delivery to your house is included in that price. Just remember that it is a sports type, so there is no basket at all, either on the front or on the back.
partB.explain: ②は価格もかごも満たすが the shop has no van at all で条件C（配達）が不成立。③は配達無料・かごありだが twenty-five thousand yen で条件A（2万円以下）を満たさない。④は12,000円で配達込みだが no basket at all で条件Bが不成立。①のみ eighteen thousand yen（A）・a large metal basket（B）・bring it to your door at no extra charge（C）の3条件すべてを満たす。安い金額に飛びつかず3項目を最後まで照合すること。
keyPhrases: the shop will bring it to your door at no extra charge
the shop has no van at all, so you would have to ride it home yourself
it is twenty-five thousand yen, which is five thousand over the limit you set
there is no basket at all, either on the front or on the back

front.situation: 先生が、生徒が家で使う4種類の機器の利用時間が学年とともにどう変わるかをグラフで説明している。あなたはグラフの4本の棒の系列名を答える。
front.worksheetTitle: Time Spent on Devices at Home

blanks.label: the series that is highest in every school year
the series that falls as the school year goes up
the series that goes up and then comes down
the series that is lowest in every school year

front.script: Look at the results of our survey on how long students use each device at home. Smartphones come first in every year, and the gap grows wider as students get older. Televisions show the opposite pattern: the older the students are, the less they watch. Game consoles are interesting. They rise from the first year to the second, and then drop again in the third year. Radios are used the least in all three years, and the bar is so short that some students may never use one.
front.explain: 4本の棒（系列）と4つのカテゴリ名を対応させる本試験型。come first in every year（③Smartphones）、the older the students are, the less they watch（④Televisions＝一貫下降）、rise ... and then drop again（①Game consoles＝山型）、used the least in all three years（②Radios＝最下位）。「上がって下がる」山型を見落とすと①と②を混同する。
keyPhrases: Smartphones come first in every year
the older the students are, the less they watch
They rise from the first year to the second, and then drop again in the third year
Radios are used the least in all three years

back.situation: 美術館の職員が、館内の各階に何があるかを説明している。あなたは表の空欄を埋める。
back.script: Welcome to our museum. Let me tell you what is on each floor. Right at the top, on the fourth floor, you can sit down with a cup of coffee and enjoy the view of the park. One floor below that, we are showing black-and-white pictures taken by a famous local photographer. The second floor is where our newest oil paintings hang. On the ground floor, near the exit, you can buy postcards and souvenirs. The basement is only for parking. Our stone sculptures, I'm sorry to say, are being cleaned and cannot be seen this month.
back.explain: 「4階から順に下へ」という説明順を追う型。a cup of coffee ＝①Café、black-and-white pictures taken by a photographer ＝⑤Photography exhibition、our newest oil paintings ＝④Modern paintings、postcards and souvenirs ＝③Gift shop。⑥Stone sculptures は cannot be seen this month で否定、②Children's workshop は未言及。One floor below that が3階を指すと正しく処理できるかが鍵。
keyPhrases: on the fourth floor, you can sit down with a cup of coffee
we are showing black-and-white pictures taken by a famous local photographer
The second floor is where our newest oil paintings hang
you can buy postcards and souvenirs
are being cleaned and cannot be seen this month

partB.situation: あなたは週末に泊まる宿を1つ選ぼうとしている。4人の説明を聞き、3つの条件をすべて満たすものを選ぶ。
conditionsEn: A. Breakfast is included in the price
B. It is within a ten-minute walk of the station
C. You can cancel for free on the day before
conditionsJa: A. 料金に朝食が含まれていること
B. 駅から徒歩10分以内であること
C. 前日まで無料でキャンセルできること
partB.question: You are most likely to choose ( 26 ).
scripts: Hotel Aoi is only four minutes from the east exit of the station, and a hot breakfast is served free of charge. But their rule is strict: once you book, you must pay half the price if you cancel, even a week in advance.

Sakura Inn stands right next to the station, about six minutes on foot. Breakfast with rice and soup is part of the room price, and you can call off your stay up to the evening before without paying anything.

Star Lodge lets you cancel free of charge until the day before, and morning coffee and toast are included. The one thing to check is the distance. It takes a good twenty-five minutes to walk there, though a bus does run.

River House is just five minutes from the station, and cancelling the day before costs you nothing. The rooms are lovely, but no meals are served at all, so you would have to find breakfast somewhere in the town.
partB.explain: ①は朝食無料・駅4分だが、you must pay half the price if you cancel で条件C（無料キャンセル）が不成立。③は無料キャンセル・朝食込みだが twenty-five minutes to walk で条件Bを満たさない（バスがある点に惑わされないこと。条件は「徒歩10分以内」）。④は駅5分・無料キャンセルだが no meals are served at all で条件Aが不成立。②のみ six minutes on foot（B）・Breakfast ... is part of the room price（A）・call off your stay up to the evening before without paying anything（C）の3条件すべてを満たす。
keyPhrases: you must pay half the price if you cancel, even a week in advance
you can call off your stay up to the evening before without paying anything
It takes a good twenty-five minutes to walk there, though a bus does run
no meals are served at all

front.situation: スポーツクラブのコーチが、けがをした後に体を戻していく手順を説明している。あなたはワークシートのイラストを正しい順に並べる。
choices: An athlete lifting a heavy barbell in a gym
An athlete sitting on a bench with a bag of ice on one knee
An athlete walking slowly around a running track
An athlete sitting on the floor stretching one leg forward
An athlete running fast on a track with other runners
front.script: If you hurt your leg, don't rush back. In the first few days, all you should do is rest and hold ice against the injury. Only when the swelling has gone should you begin gentle stretching on the floor. Once that feels comfortable, the next stage is walking, not running, around the track. Racing with the others comes last, and not before your coach says you are ready. And please, no weight training during any of this. Heavy lifting has to wait until the whole programme is over.
front.explain: 順序標識が明示的でなく、Only when ... should you / Once that feels comfortable / comes last という構文で段階が示される難度の高い型。②ice →④stretching →③walking →⑤racing。ダミーは①のウェイトで、no weight training during any of this / Heavy lifting has to wait により除外される。walking, not running の対比を聞き逃すと③と⑤が入れ替わる。
keyPhrases: all you should do is rest and hold ice against the injury
Only when the swelling has gone should you begin gentle stretching on the floor
the next stage is walking, not running, around the track
Racing with the others comes last
no weight training during any of this

back.situation: 国際交流委員の生徒が、来週の交流イベントの各時間帯の内容を説明している。あなたは表の空欄を埋める。
back.script: Let me run through Exchange Day. We open at half past nine in the hall, where everyone shares snacks and gets to know the guests. An hour later, in Room 201, you will sit in small circles and talk about school life in each country. There is a long lunch break, and then at one o'clock we move to the cooking room to wrap and boil dumplings together. Finally, back in the hall at three, a few students from each side will say a word of thanks before the buses leave. The dance the guests prepared has been cancelled, sadly.

partB.situation: あなたは夏休みに参加する短期の海外プログラムを1つ選ぼうとしている。4人の説明を聞き、3つの条件をすべて満たすものを選ぶ。
conditionsEn: A. It lasts three weeks or less
B. You stay with a host family
C. It offers a class for beginners
conditionsJa: A. 期間が3週間以内であること
B. ホームステイであること
C. 初級者向けのクラスがあること
partB.question: You are most likely to choose ( 26 ).
scripts: Program Alpha is three weeks on the dot. You stay in a host family's house near the school, and the timetable has a beginners' group in the mornings, so you can start from zero without any worry.

Program Beta is exactly two weeks, and they put you in a shared room in a student dormitory, not with a family. Classes start from the very basics, so even if you know nothing at all you will manage well enough.

Program Gamma lasted eighteen days for me, and I lived with a wonderful host family in the suburbs. But be careful about the classes. There is no beginner course; everyone has to take the intermediate lessons from day one.

Program Delta runs for a full five weeks, which is rather long. You do live with a local family the whole time, and there are classes at every level, including one for complete beginners who have never studied the language before.
partB.explain: ④はホームステイ・初級クラスありだが a full five weeks で条件A（3週間以内）が不成立。②は2週間・初級から学べるが a student dormitory, not with a family で条件Bが不成立。③は18日・ホームステイだが There is no beginner course で条件Cが不成立。①のみ three weeks on the dot（A：ちょうど3週間なので「3週間以内」を満たす）・a host family's house（B）・a beginners' group in the mornings（C）を満たす。「eighteen days」「three weeks on the dot」のように期間表現が日数と週で混在するため換算が必要。

they put you in a shared room in a student dormitory, not with a family

front.situation: 留学生が、自分の国で人気のある4つの移動手段の利用者の割合が20年でどう変わったかを説明している。あなたはグラフの4本の線の系列名を答える。

blanks.label: the line that was first in 2005 but is no longer first
the line that became first by 2025
the line that grew the fastest after 2015
the line that went down and never recovered

front.script: This graph shows how people in my city get to work. Cars were used by the most people in 2005, but they lost their top place about ten years later. Trains took over that top place and have stayed there since. Buses have simply gone down, year after year, and they have never come back up. The most surprising line is bicycles. They were almost flat until 2015, and after that they have shot up faster than anything else, though they are still not in first place.
front.explain: 「順位の入れ替わり」を扱う型。were used by the most people in 2005, but they lost their top place（③Cars）、took over that top place（④Trains）、almost flat until 2015, and after that ... shot up faster than anything else（①Bicycles）、simply gone down, year after year（②Buses）。問20は「2015年以降の伸び」という限定条件で、全期間の順位ではないことに注意。
keyPhrases: Cars were used by the most people in 2005, but they lost their top place
Trains took over that top place and have stayed there since

front.script: This chart shows how students in my country study English.
